body:
Ruling: batch #239 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-28T14:29Z

Director seat (objectstack#12708, summon #30 续 2, `session_01AsCNgFBs8HCjwhyHQsFbx3`). Provenance: maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-28, replying 「同意」 to batch #239 as presented — this card item 1, recommendation A, fallback C, B not recommended, D (the html tier running the zod door over the compiled tree) named as out of this card, the full four-axis body in chat.

**Ruled: A.** The html tier adds no authoring-time report for "one of two ways to name the object". The runtime notice (PR objectui#10989: an `element:number` with an `aggregate` and no object in either place draws a localized 「no object named」 state instead of the silent dash) is the answer to objectui#10951, and it is the whole answer. The sdui manifest stays the coarse contract it is (`name` / `type` / `of` / `required` / `enum` / `binding` / `description`; presence rule `input.required && !(input.name in node)`, `validate.ts:111`); no one-of vocabulary enters it, and no per-tag arm enters `validateTree`. The same answer settles the sibling families: `element:record_picker` (object or binding) and the calendar / gantt record source of objectui#10508 stay as they are. B (a parser-local `checkOneOf` helper with a per-family table, ported by lockstep) and C (a component-level `requiredOneOf` manifest construct, `Clause-②: yes`) are not taken; D is not opened here.

Readings that decided it:
- Long-term: this is the design objectui#7470 / objectui#10392 already chose for map, gantt and calendar — the `required` flag left the registration, the docblock says 「no one-of vocabulary is added to the input declaration; the zod refinement stays the place that enforces it」, and `requireRecordSource` (`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:1935`) refuses on the JSON door. `element:number` joined that family with PR objectui#10944 and PR objectui#10908 (the `properties.object` arm with the `dataSource.object` waiver). One family, one shape; C would have been the contract-first alternative and is recorded as the shape to take if the refusal is ever wanted back — never B.
- Real use: 0 non-test `element:number` authoring sites in objectui examples / apps and in objectstack examples (`git grep` on `origin/main`, `element:text` as the lit control); the mistake is visible wherever the page renders once objectui#10989 lands. AI page authoring is the producer at risk and is NOT MEASURED.
- AI-safety: the weakest axis for A, stated plainly: a JSX page naming no object saves and publishes clean on the html tier and is caught at render, not at publish. Accepted because the JSON door and the spec's props gate (`@objectstack/lint` `validateComponentProps`, `dataSource.object` waiver) already refuse the same node on the metadata path, and because the manifest cannot say "one of" without a new contract.
- Startup scope: no new gate (「新增门禁默认否」 holds; nothing measured pulls for the exception), no contract widening, no lockstep regeneration; the card closes with no code.

Execution parameters (ruled in the same stroke):
- This card closes `completed` with this ruling; no dispatch. `needs-user-decision` leaves; `domain:ui` stays as the lane of record.
- objectui#10951: (b) is settled by this ruling (one line goes on that card); its seat lands PR objectui#10989 for (a) and closes the card on that PR.
- objectui#10508's calendar / gantt trade and `element:record_picker`: unchanged; no card.
- Recorded, not opened: C is the shape if an authoring-time one-of report is ever wanted (one `requiredOneOf?: string[][]` on `ManifestComponent`, `manifestFromConfigs` pass-through, a `missing-one-of` diagnostic naming both spellings, four family declarations, lockstep regeneration); D (the JSX doors handing the compiled tree to the zod door / the spec props gate) is a separate question about the html tier as a whole and is not filed by this ruling.

State: `needs-user-decision` removed; card closed `completed`; the Ruled line goes on the body in the same stroke.
